config.labsFolder.description: Folder where labs are saved, one `<name>.lab.json` file per lab. A relative path is resolved against the first workspace folder; an absolute path is used as it is. Leave empty to use the default: the `data` folder of the Spec Studio package (see **Use Spec Package**), or `data` in the workspace.
config.useSpecPackage.description: When Spec Studio is installed and the workspace has its package folder (`<workspace name>-spec`), save labs in its `data` folder. Applies only when **Labs Folder** is empty.
